instructions_to_main_agent: Follow Central Bar and Grill's authentic Toronto Jamaican aesthetic: Deep obsidian charcoal base (#0D0B0A), warm ember accents (#EA580C), golden amber highlights (#F59E0B), and lush Caribbean green touches (#10B981).

Customer Ordering Flow: 1) Scan QR or select Table Number (1-20), 2) Browse rich categories: Appetizers, Entrees, Seafood, Seafood Thursday, Your Combo, Sides, Signatures, Island Blends, 3) Select pairing options (e.g. Rice & Peas vs White Rice, Spice Level, Side festival), 4) Place order with optional customer name & phone for SMS/text simulation, 5) Live auto-updating Order Status page with 3-step tracker (Received -> Preparing -> Ready) + generated Order Claim QR code + Web Audio bell chime on Ready.

Staff / Kitchen Dashboard Flow (/staff): Live kanban board grouped into 'New / Received', 'Preparing / Kitchen', 'Ready for Pickup / Table Delivery'. Real-time 1-click status advancement buttons, sound chime on incoming orders, audio bell on ready. Include filter by table, time elapsed timer, and quick search.

Table QR Code Generator & Receipt Claim: Dedicated /staff/tables page generating QR codes for Tables 1 to 16 with instant SVG QR rendering, printable table tent cards, and direct scan preview buttons. Every receipt on the customer status page displays a scannable Order Claim QR Code.

Include pre-seeded realistic menu items from Central Bar and Grill (Jerk Chicken, Curry Goat, Oxtail, Rasta Pasta, Bang Bang Shrimp, Garlic Butter Seafood, Rum Punch, Fried Plantains, Festivals, Bammy).
Implement Web Audio API synth chimes for audio alerts when orders change status (zero external audio asset dependencies).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or full-screen flat gradients. Use deep warm obsidian tones with subtle borders and glowing accents.
Every interactive button, input, tab, and card must include explicit data-testid attributes for automated testing.
Use Shadcn Sheet for cart drawer, Shadcn Dialog for item customizer & QR preview, and Sonner for toast notifications.
Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Deliver rich cultural authenticity reflecting Central Bar & Grill's 2006 Jamaican roots.
